title: A host-observed test run stays "running" in /api/test-runs hours after its bound item completed
outcome: An observed run row whose process is gone and whose bound work has completed leaves the running state, or carries an explicit stale/unknown status, so lanes and coordinators do not mistake it for a live run.
acceptance: A test reproduces an observed run whose bound work completes and whose process is gone, and shows the row leaving the running state (or being marked stale with a reason) within a bounded time.
Rows of genuinely live runs are unaffected, and the change is covered by a regression test.
